entries.be3f5778fb638a9e: Packaging Materials and Other Manufacturing and Sales Business
entries.c46db68f2e16feed: This is the only business of the company group, manufacturing and selling light food packaging materials and industrial packaging materials, and it is also treated as a single segment in segment information. It consists of the company and six consolidated subsidiaries: Kohsoku Shīpakku (printed paperboard boxes), Seiwa (tea-related packaging materials), Nihon Kontekku (logistics equipment and materials), Purasu Hōsō Shisutemu (synthetic resin products), Tokiwa Pakkēji (corrugated cardboard and others), and Kohsoku Shīringu (seals and labels), which are responsible for manufacturing and sales.
entries.ec230c74d29fb19d: These include packaging machines, food processing machines, logistics machinery, kitchen equipment, store-related equipment, logistics equipment and materials such as containers, pallets and cage carts, tapes, and hygiene consumables, etc. The year-on-year ratio of sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 108.0%.
